title: Cross-site scripting (XSS)
body: XSS happens when a page shows user input as HTML or script without escaping it. An attacker can then run code in other users' browsers, for example to steal a session cookie. Defenders: escape output, use a content security policy and mark session cookies HttpOnly. How to spot it: type something like test in a comment or search box; if it shows up in bold instead of as plain text, the page does not escape output. Real tests use scripts, but bold text proves the hole.
